visualCharacteristics: Centered tabs with model counts, horizontal slider of model cards (car on street backdrop, compare icon, name, price with info-i, icon fact rows aligned across cards or check-mark bullets, outline CTAs); arrows on desktop, dots on mobile
contentPattern: Rows: [tab title] starts a tab; [car image (optionally linked) | h3 (+ branding image), price paragraph, list of facts 'label value' or plain bullet list | CTA links, compare link to /de/bmw-modelle-vergleichen]; last single-cell row = info-i text for the prices.
